title: The joint scaling limit of critical Ashkin-Teller currents

abstractEnglish: For each fixed point on the critical Ashkin–Teller line, including the four-state Potts endpoint, we prove the conjectured joint scaling limit of the height and both current-cluster collections in every bounded Jordan domain, for every admissible polygonal approximation. The height converges to a Gaussian free field with the predicted coupling constant, and the clusters converge to canonical recursive two-valued local sets of that same field. The joint limit includes all nesting depths and the distinguished wired boundary cluster.
